scope: Whole-game provisional ratings from two bounded ordinary-input attempts, deployment to west triage bay.

method.browser: Installed Chrome headless via Playwright, SwiftShader software rendering, 1280x800, ?test=1
method.decisions: Visible screenshots, UI text, briefing and handbook only. No gameplay coordinates or internal enemy/player data used for decisions.
method.inputs: Timed ordinary WASD/R/E/Shift keys, mouse click/movement; second attempt used DOM mouse listener events to supply relative look and held fire. No teleport, resource edits or enemy edits.
method.priorKnowledge: Task identified west medical bay and Mara memory, alternate-route goal. No prior gameplay source knowledge.
method.sourceDisclosure: Read package.json for Playwright dependency before play. After initial mouse/nav trouble inspected src/game.js lines 145–170 input listeners. After both attempts searched captureState hook in main.js; captured state only after all actions ended.
method.advantagesAndLimits: Deterministic timed input durations and event injection; screenshots leave elapsed simulation time while inspecting, imposing combat disadvantage. Software renderer cannot certify audio, enjoyment or hardware FPS.

attempts.outcome: Lost at 00:46, 0 eliminations, 0 cores. Reached triage doorway; mouse movement initially turned/pitched unexpectedly and cover blocked forward progress. No shots fired.

Lost at 00:36, 1 elimination, 1 critical elimination, score 180, 18% accuracy, 0 cores. Fired at visible initial guard, reloaded, navigated around service cover into medical bay. Core visibly read 3m; held E but no memory recovered. Two bay sentinels were announced by UI but not successfully located/engaged on screen. Alternate departure not attempted after death.

findings.detail: Atmospheric rainy yard, reflections, cyan/amber palette, coherent typography and responsive outcome screens create a strong authored identity.
Visible triage signage, west objective marker and a bay entrance made the destination discoverable without source lookup. Briefing and handbook explain recovery, extraction and dash timing.

Core marker and recovery radius were hard to reconcile: visibly at 3m and holding E produced no recovery before death. This session cannot establish whether the player was outside range, obstructed or killed before initiation; needs clearer nearby interaction affordance.

Bay incoming damage was difficult to attribute visually: health fell while camera faced core and UI announced two sentinels, but I did not acquire the attackers. A clearer readable approach/cover-to-threat composition would help.

Initial service cover stopped forward navigation; screenshot inspection and an unintended look adjustment consumed dangerous exposure. This limits fairness conclusions, but demonstrates limited tolerance for a new operator pausing to understand the space.
Title screen visibly still says BUILD 09 while this review targets Build15; duplicated tutorial/event text competes with objective labels on right.
